CustomField.description: Not all statuses are reachable by direct write. Paid on a real gift typically requires an associated payment or NPC reconciliation flow. Direct-writing Status = 'Paid' on insert works for seed and test data but bypasses normal payment posting — do not use for production ingest. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where this gift is in the payment cycle. Choose Pending for gifts you've recorded financially but not yet received, Paid once the payment is in hand.
